findings.body: task-packets/TP-DMX-MD-R6-WORKFLOW-SETUPPYTHON-001.json fails both oneOf branches of schemas/governed_execution/task_packet.v2.schema.json (no schema_version/macro_id/workstream_id/risk_lane; execution.agent 'shell' with pal_chain.enabled false). Sibling packets TP-DMX-DEPENDABOT-ACTIONS-TOKEN-1169-001 and TP-DMX-STEWARD-DEPENDABOT-ACTOR-1207-001 fail identically and none of the 289 files in task-packets/ carries schema_version, so v2 is not the governing schema for this family. Key set matches precedent except pal_chain and execution.stacked_because. Required invariants are present. validate_change_contract.py passes.
findings.title: Task packet is legacy-shape, not task_packet.v2-conformant

findings.body: Only python-version (3.11 or 3.12) is passed to setup-python in the five files. There is no cache, check-latest or other input, and all 18 runs-on values are ubuntu-latest, so input-surface risk is minimal. Tag v7/v7.0.0 exists upstream (5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97, verified via git ls-remote). Release notes were not read, and no workflow was executed by the auditor, so CI on the PR is the first runtime proof.
findings.title: Workflows not executed; v7 upstream changelog not independently reviewed

findings.body: setup-python@v7 is a floating major tag, not a SHA pin. This matches the prior @v5 form and the other actions in these files, so it is no regression. SHA pinning is out of scope.
findings.title: Mutable major-tag pin, consistent with existing convention
